Foundation for Civil Society (FCS) Efficiency Audit

description.narrative: The FCS efficiency audit aims at assessing whether the organisation’s internal management & control systems are adequate to ensure quality and accuracy. It assesses if the organisation has appropriate systems and routines for managing the organisation’s activities to achieve the operational goals. The efficiency audit is expected to find eventual weaknesses and to suggest actions to address these.
